name: glass-slideshow
title: Glass Slideshow
description: An OGL-powered slideshow with liquid glass image transitions, chromatic fringing, and optional autoplay.

usage.label: Astro
React
Vue
usage.code:
<script setup>
import "@/components/motion-kit/glass-slideshow-element.ts";

const slides = [
  { src: "/images/slide1.jpg", alt: "Slide 1" },
  { src: "/images/slide2.jpg", alt: "Slide 2" },
  { src: "/images/slide3.jpg", alt: "Slide 3" }
];
</script>

<template>
  <motion-glass-slideshow
    :images="JSON.stringify(slides)"
    :index="0"
    :transition-duration="2000"
    :intensity="1"
    :distortion="1"
    :chromatic-aberration="1"
    :refraction="1"
    :autoplay="true"
    :autoplay-interval="5000"
    class="w-full h-[600px]"
  />
</template>

props.name: images
props.description: JSON array of slide objects with src (URL) and optional alt text.

props.name: index
props.description: Current slide index (updates on transition when autoplay is false).

props.name: transition-duration
props.description: Duration of the glass transition effect in milliseconds.

props.name: intensity
props.description: Overall intensity of the glass distortion and refraction effects.

props.name: distortion
props.description: Strength of the liquid distortion during transitions.

props.name: chromatic-aberration
props.description: Intensity of RGB color splitting at refracted edges.

props.name: refraction
props.description: Strength of the glass lens refraction effect.

props.name: autoplay-interval
props.description: Time between automatic slide advances in milliseconds.
